extracted.name: Colene's Easy Tomato Vegetable Soup
extracted.description: An easy soup made by combining canned tomato juice with oregano and a bag of mixed frozen vegetables. Add macaroni pasta for a different variation.
instruction_lines: Combine tomato juice, water, mixed vegetables, oregano, and salt in a large pot over medium heat; simmer for 30 minutes. Season with pepper to taste.
